1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 1 m de longitud, con boca grande y aletas radiadas, de color plateado con el margen de las aletas negro. Congridae; Conger triporiceps.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish up to 1 m in length, with a large mouth and radiated fins, silver-colored with black margins on the fins. Family Congridae; species Conger triporiceps.
